{"content":"Remove the FFS in the sub-bullet of 3rd bullet in RAN1#120bis agreement on UCI multiplexing.\nUE does not expect there are multiple PUCCHs without repetitions in different PUCCH slots with a same or different UCI types other than SR overlapping with multiple PUSCH repetitions in the same OCC group.\nFFS: whether the above applies only when at least one of the overlapping PUCCHs result in a UCI being multiplexed on the PUSCH","hasFFS":true,"hasTBD":false,"resolutionId":"AGR-121-9.11.3-006","sequence":6}
